name: Summit Insulated Trail Mug
description: A 12 oz double-wall stainless steel mug with a slide-lock lid. Keeps coffee hot for about 5 hours and fits most car cup holders. Dishwasher safe.

name: Ridgeline 22L Daypack
description: A lightweight daypack with a padded laptop sleeve, hydration bladder port, and water-resistant recycled nylon shell. Ideal for day hikes and commuting.

name: Emberline Compact Camp Stove
description: A folding single-burner canister stove that boils a liter of water in about 4 minutes. Weighs 3.2 oz and packs into its own pouch.

name: Birchwood Camp Cutting Board
description: A folding cutting board made from sustainably harvested birch with a juice groove. Folds in half to slide into a pack or kitchen drawer.

name: Lumen 400 Rechargeable Headlamp
description: A 400-lumen USB-C rechargeable headlamp with a red night-vision mode and a lock-out switch so it never turns on in your bag. Lasts up to 40 hours on low.

name: Drift Packable Down Blanket
description: A 650-fill responsibly sourced down blanket that packs down to the size of a water bottle. Warm enough for cool summer nights by the fire.

name: Canopy Two-Person Hammock
description: A parachute-nylon hammock rated to 400 lbs, with tree-friendly straps included. Sets up in under two minutes with no knots needed.

name: Trailmix 1L Filter Bottle
description: A squeeze water bottle with a built-in filter that removes 99.9% of bacteria and protozoa. Each filter cartridge lasts about 1,000 liters.

name: Fieldnotes Waterproof Journal
description: A pocket-sized notebook with waterproof stone paper pages that you can write on in the rain with any ballpoint pen. 64 pages, dot grid.

name: Granite 10-inch Cast Iron Skillet
description: A pre-seasoned cast iron skillet that works on a campfire, grill, or home stovetop. Heavy, durable, and gets better with every use.
